title: Chorizo Steamed Clams
description: These flavorful steamed clams and chorizo are not only easy and delicious but also fast to make. The spicy chorizo sausage adds so much flavor.
ingredients: 3 ounces Spanish chorizo sausage, quartered lengthwise, cut into1/4-inch pieces
3 pounds littleneck clams, scrubbed and rinsed

steps.text: Heat olive oil in a large pot over medium heat. Add onions; cook and stir until onions start to turn translucent, 3 to 4 minutes. Add chorizo; cook and stir to render some fat, about 3 minutes. Add garlic and cook until fragrant, about 1 minute.

Pour in wine, increase the heat to high, and bring liquid to a boil. Immediately add clams and distribute evenly. Cover and cook until clams open, about 7 minutes, shaking the pot occasionally by holding the pot handles with potholders or a kitchen towel. It's best not to open the lid and stir.
When clams have opened, remove from the heat. Stir in parsley and butter.
Serve clams and liquid in heated bowls.

video.description: Delicious and easy to make, this dish starts with littleneck clams, the smallest of the hard-shell clams then adds on the flavors with diced chorizo, onion, garlic, parsley and white wine. Serve yourself up a bowl full of flavorful broth, freshly cooked clams and super savory and smoky chorizo with some fresh bread to soak up all the spice. Serve with the rest of your wine!
